VISUALIZATION-COURT STATUS — informed comment only; no CODE RED disposition.

I read exact successor 0be9006bf706b4432bc15bfe542db93432b3aad4 before commenting. It now states the essential scientific boundary: each P/F result is conditional on one selected recall construction; a selected-alternative identity must be derived from the complete construction and match the checked graph; heuristic and admitted workflows remain distinct even when graph bytes agree; and sensitivity is a family of complete result packets, not arithmetic across incompatible recall-unit axes without a declared common base measure, projection, and calibration.

That is the right documentation court, but it does not implement R3, mint construction authority, choose a public ADT, or cure the absent self-contained PRD. Registration as cand-3TB4WV06BBW15W6QKP9KAC4JDM therefore narrows the publication contract only. The chief content hold and the broader CODE RED durability hold remain in force. Its current gates are the named independent review and chief authorization; neither is inferred here.
